text:
amy.sales: Heads up AcmeCorp just dropped a late POC ask: they require a documented cutover playbook for BYO-HSM that supports monthly automated rotation, dual-custodian ceremony during cutover, and a scoped pen-test window. They want this by EOD tomorrow. Can we confirm feasibility and top-line runbook?

omar.engineering: Feasible. We run BYO-HSM through our HSM-proxy + per-tenant VM isolation. For rotation we support API-driven unwrap/wrap flow. Dual-custodian ceremonies are external to our control-plane but we can: 1) provide a step-by-step ceremony script, 2) emit attestation nonces and signed statements at each step, 3) host a zoom with their ops during the ceremony.

lucy.security: Quick security checklist to include in playbook: attestation cert + nonce, HSM firmware & FIPS level, policy that key material is non-exportable, signed audit snapshots after each ceremony step, and 2-person approval gates logged to both sides' SIEMs. If they insist on hardware split custody inside our hosted environment, we need PS engagement.

patrik.sre: Operational constraints: rolling swap recommended. Playbook: 
- Preflight: test connectivity + attestations, whitelist proxy IPs
- Dry-run in staging with simulated custodians (we can generate test nonces)
- Production cutover: 30m maintenance window, staged traffic shift (10%, 50%, 100%) with 5m stabilization at each stage
- Rollback: switch back to old KEK and mark new key deprecated
We can include health-check commands + rollback commands.

jen.solutions: Pricing implications: BYO-HSM POC -> addendum +15-25% depending on ops involvement. If they want Redwood to staff the ceremony (aka PS), that's an hourly PS line item. I'll draft a short pricing appendix for the SOW.

amy.sales: They also asked if monthly rotation can be fully customer-initiated (they call our API) without downtime. Short answer?

omar.engineering: Yes. Customer-initiated rotation pattern:
1) customer creates new wrapping key on their HSM
2) update Redwood mapping via our key API to stage new KEK for 10m overlap
3) traffic flips to new KEK (we keep a cached unwrap prefix to reduce HSM calls)
4) after validation, deprecate old KEK
This yields near-continuous availability. Expect brief (single-digit ms) added latency on first unwrap per prefix when cache misses occur.

lucy.security: Note: we need their attestation each rotation and a signed rotation record. Also require the customer to present their HSM's key usage policy and rotation authorization logs monthly.

patrik.sre: Pen-test: we allow tests against staging proxy + control-plane with signed pentest contract. Recommend they test during staging dry-run, not during the production cutover. Need 7 business days notice for scheduling.

amy.sales: Good. Can someone paste a minimal connectivity check snippet for them (they asked for an ops-friendly quick test)?

omar.engineering: Paste: 
curl -v --cert client.crt --key client.key \ 
  https://hsm-proxy.acme-staging.redwood.ai/health 
  --cacert /path/to/attestation_root.pem
Response should be: {"status":"ok","attestation_nonce":"<nonce>"} if attestation is available.

jen.solutions: I'll attach: 1) SOW addendum draft, 2) pricing appendix, 3) suggested PS hourly rates. Link will be in the deal doc by EOD.

amy.sales: Action items: jen - SOW + pricing appendix; lucy - ceremony script + one-paragraph answer for security questionnaire Q12 about multi-custodian; omar - sample curl + minimal integration checklist + perf hit note; patrik - full cutover runbook + rollback playbook + pentest scheduling form. I'll consolidate and send to AcmeCorp PM.

redwood-bot: File uploaded: ACMECORP_BYOHSM_Cutover_Playbook_DRAFT.pdf

amy.sales: Thanks all. If PS is needed for on-site ceremony we may request a short quote tomorrow. Ping here if anything blocks meeting the EOD deliverable.
